source_note: Mosselora is the current public working name; Evergrove remains the internal project codename and slug. Unity 6.3 Chapter One playtest prototype; Editor and device builds are not verified.

apple.name: Mosselora
apple.subtitle: A Living Garden
apple.description:
Restore a village stream one pipe puzzle at a time. Rotate tiles to connect the spring to the garden, watch water reach the route, then choose what to restore: shade trees, a footbridge or wildflowers.

Your choice changes the next stream and the village story. Follow twelve chapters, revisit your journal and see how a small set of decisions combine. Optional hints, undo and restart let you take the puzzle at your own pace.

Play offline, without an account or network connection. Progress is saved on this device.

release_decisions.privacy_and_data_safety: Desktop Development-player binary inspection found no third-party SDK assemblies; Unity cloud services are disabled; WorldClient is compiled but unattached; no outbound TCP was seen in four samples during one approximately 6-second run, but a Development Player Connection listener on TCP 55000 was present. This does not verify a mobile release or establish no traffic. Signed iOS/Android binary inspection, controlled device network capture and account-owner disclosures remain pending.
release_decisions.automatic_release: Apple iOS 1.0: Automatically release after App Review selected and read back; no submission. Google: standard publishing requested; app record not created.
release_decisions.title_clearance: USPTO search on 2026-11-23: exact wordmark Mosselora returned no results; root mossel returned five results, including live registered MOSSEL in IC 010 and live pending MOSSEL in IC 017 for foam supports for floral arrangements. Preliminary federal screen only; full legal clearance remains pending.
